verses.1: Do not trust in yourselves, O Macedonians, and do not stiffen your necks, O Amalekites, for there is a God who watches over you.
verses.2: For though you ascend up to heaven, you shall be brought down to Sheol.
verses.3: And as in former days, when the children of Israel were in the land of Egypt, in the kingdom of the Medes and the Moabites, He said: Do not trust in yourselves, for the visitation of God is not far from you, that He should visit you.
verses.4: And you also, O son of the maidservant, you Ishmaelite, why do you stiffen your neck toward that which is not yours? Do you not remember that God will judge you on the day of judgment, as when He arose to judge the earth?
verses.5: Even then you will be judged according to the work of your hands. Why do you lift up your heart and stiffen your neck? says God, who sees all things.
verses.6: And I also will visit you as I visited those who were before you; and moreover I have sent you, for you shall do the evil that you desire.
verses.7: And likewise I also will deal with you, says God, who sees all things. And as for you, if you do good and love what I love, I also will hear you in all that you ask of Me.
verses.8: And I will do your will, if you do My will; and I will establish your enemy for you, and I will bless your deeds, your seed, and your children.
verses.9: And I will bless the pasture of your cattle and your flocks, and I will bless everything to which you put your hand, if you walk in My commandments and do what I love, says God, who sees all things.
verses.10: But if you do not do My will and do not walk in My commandments, all these judgments that were spoken of old shall come upon you; and you shall not be able to escape My scourges that shall come upon you at all times, because you did not walk in My commandments and did not walk in My judgments.
verses.11: And I will not destroy you as I destroy others, and I will not cut you off from My praise and from My worship, since I created you when you did not exist.
verses.12: And I gave you glory and praise among the people who are under you, so that you may do all that you desire: to kill and to spare, to build up and to tear down, to honor and to bind, to exalt and to bring low—this is yours.
verses.13: If you do the will of God and walk in His commandments, He will love you, so that you may rejoice with Him in His kingdom and be a partaker with those who inherit the holy city.
verses.14: For He says: Those who obey Me, I will make them inherit glory and favor, and I will make them rejoice in My house of prayer, and they shall be chosen and elect, like a sacrifice of offering, says God, who sees all things.
verses.15: Do not be negligent in doing good and in the way of salvation, that you may pass from death into life.
verses.16: And as for those who keep the doing of good, God will be their refuge in every good thing, that they may be His servants, like Job, who kept himself for God from all evil.
verses.17: And like Abraham, whom He saved when they sought to kill the queen; and as He saved Moses from the hand of Pharaoh and from the hands of the Canaanites, among whom Abraham dwelt, while he guarded his life, rising early and keeping watch day and night, that he might bring them down to their idols.
verses.18: And he was patient while he endured them in their idols, while he rebuked them.
verses.19: And he also, while he endured them, feared God who created him; for Abraham was faithful to God, in whom he believed from his youth.
verses.20: And he did not forsake the worship of God until the day of his death, for he loved God exceedingly, and he did not transgress His commandment until the day of his death; and he commanded his children to keep the commandment of God.
verses.21: And they also did not transgress His commandment, according to the deed of their father, the seed of Abraham; His servants did not transgress the commandment of God—Isaac and Jacob, concerning whom God spoke, saying to His angels: I have sworn.
verses.22: Upon the earth: Abraham My beloved, and Isaac My chosen one, and Jacob, in whom My soul delights, from whom I am glorified, says God, who sees all things.
verses.23: And the children of Israel, moreover, while He led them continually, He also fed them and gave them manna to drink in the wilderness.
verses.24: And their garments did not wear out, and their feet did not become sore, for they drank manna, which is the bread of understanding.
verses.25: But their heart was always far from God, and they had no hope of salvation, for from the beginning they were doers of evil.
verses.26: And they were not like their fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who pleased God in the conduct of their lives; but they were like a twisted bow, and they always provoked Him with their idols, with their high places, and with their groves; and they ate in the high places, in the groves, and under the shady trees.
verses.27: And they slaughtered and sacrificed and rejoiced in the work of their hands; and they ate sacrifices and drank their drink offerings, and they sang and made merry with demons.
verses.28: And the demons made them taste of all their fornication and their revelry, and of all their drunkenness and adultery, without measure, and of greed and lasciviousness, in which God takes no pleasure.
verses.29: And they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and to Baal, and to the Mariam of the Medes, and to the idols of the Philistines, Dagon and Apollo, and to Artemis, and to Ratzion.
verses.30: And to all the gods of the nations round about they worshipped, all of them, as the nations did, in what they saw and in what they heard, and in all their revelry, their fornication, and their abominations that the nations practice.
verses.31: And likewise the people of Israel did, who say: Let us worship God, yet they do not keep the law and the commandment that Moses told them in the Torah, that they should keep the commandments of God and abstain from the worship of idols.
verses.32: And they did not worship strange gods, except the God of their fathers, who gave them drink from the rock of flint, and brought them up upon the strength of the earth, and fed them honey from the rock, and gave them manna to drink.
verses.33: And He did not deny them what they asked and what they desired, for He is their God, and He gave them to drink what they desired.
verses.34: But they did not forsake their provocation of God; and when He made them rejoice, they forgot God.
verses.35: And when He was angry with them, they cried out to Him, and He saved them from the distress in which they found themselves; and again they rejoiced in vain and dwelt in the vanity of their days.
verses.36: And again their heart turned aside, and they turned back to provoke God as at the first; and the nations round about them rose up against them to kill them, to enslave them, and to plunder them.
verses.37: And again they repented and returned and cried out to God their God.
verses.38: And He had mercy on them, not for their own sake, but for the sake of their fathers, to whom He swore and established a covenant—with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, who from of old pleased God in the conduct of their lives.
verses.39: And to those who loved Him and kept His commandment, He loved them, that He might multiply their seed like the sand of the sea and like the stars of heaven.
verses.40: And like the sand of the sea, He says, are the souls of sinners at the resurrection of the dead, those who shall enter into the sea of fire from among the children of Israel.
verses.41: But the souls of the righteous are like shining stars in the heights of heaven, from the seed of the children of Israel; for God said to Abraham: Look toward heaven by night, and count the stars of heaven, if you are able to count them. And so shall your righteous seed shine like the stars in the kingdom of heaven.
verses.42: And again He said to him: Look into the sea and at the pebbles of the river, and see what is in the sand, and count them, if you are able to count them; and so shall your seed be, those who shall go down to Sheol at the resurrection of the dead.
verses.43: And Abraham believed in God, and because of this it was reckoned to him as righteousness; and he found his hope upon the earth, and after the barrenness of his wife Sarah, she bore a son, Isaac.
verses.44: And again in heaven he shall receive the kingdom because of his faith, for he believed that the dead shall rise, and that those who have done good shall enter into eternal life.
verses.45: And those who have done evil shall enter into eternal judgment at the resurrection of the dead; and the righteous who have done good shall reign with Him for ever and ever.
verses.46: And those who have done evil shall be condemned for ever and ever. Amen and Amen.
